newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's SBI extends winning streak to 12th day.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's SBI extends winning streak to 12th day.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI index ended 0.18 percent higher on Friday, extending its winning streak to 12 days -- and traders said there was more to come.
"I think shares will rise gradually at least for half a year as foreigners are likely to continue investing here," one broker said.
* The SBI index rose 0.18 percent or 2.6 points to 1,460.1.
* Bank Probanka was the top gainer, jumping 8.93 percent to 22,450 tolars on volume of 190 shares.
* Drug maker Lek had the highest turnover, jumping 6.58 percent to 34,000 tolars on volume of 6,508 shares for total turnover of 215.7 million tolars. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
